title: Implement In-memory CRUD operations for tasks
acceptance_criteria: The store.py file exists and contains a TaskStore class
The TaskStore class has the exact methods: __init__, create, list, get, update, delete
The create method assigns sequential IDs and raises ValueError on invalid title
The delete method returns True if removed else False

title: Implement validation and business rules for tasks
acceptance_criteria: The service.py file exists and contains a TaskService class
The TaskService class is constructed as TaskService(store)
The TaskService class delegates to the store with exact calls: create, list, get, update, delete
The TaskService class never accesses the store's tasks or next_id directly

title: Implement HTTP handler and server creation
acceptance_criteria: The api.py file exists and contains a make_server function
The make_server function creates an HTTP server with the correct Content-Type and Content-Length headers
The make_server function uses the shared instance of TaskService
The handler uses the shared instance of TaskService to delegate to the store

title: Implement server startup and management
acceptance_criteria: The __main__.py file exists and reads the PORT env var (default 8080)
The __main__.py file builds the server with make_server and calls serve_forever
The server listens on the correct port and responds to HTTP requests
